name: web-bincabnb-cabin-rental-hero-night-with-giant-serif-wordmark
title: bincabnb cabin real estate hero: a lit modern cabin at night over water behind a giant wordmark
whatItIs: A dark blue night hero with a huge white 'bincabnb' wordmark partly behind a glowing modern cabin reflected in water, 'Find your perfect cabin escape' with an italic serif word, a video card, 'Book a call' button and a booking bar (destination, date, guests, stay period, Find Cabin).
whatItMeans: Moody and exclusive; the warm windows in the dark promise a cosy escape.
techniques: Place the hero subject in front of a giant wordmark.
Mix sans and italic serif in the headline.
Anchor a booking bar at the bottom of the hero.

vocabulary.definition: Placing objects in front of and behind type.
A horizontal search form for reservations.
